summary: Tantech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K to disclose changes to its board of directors. Effective August 12, 2026, independent directors Shudong Wang and Mengqi Liao resigned, each without any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices. The remaining board members elected Jiwen Huang and Chuanjiang Xiao as independent directors and nominating committee members to fill the vacancies, with terms expiring at the 2026 annual meeting. Both new directors meet Nasdaq independence requirements. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation, with no implications for shareholders or deal activity.
